prompt: Was the founder of the bank that was established 42 years before the National Banking Act was expanded to include the Territory of Hawai'i still alive when it acquired Pioneer Federal Savings Bank?
answer: No. The bank was founded as Bishop & Co. in 1858 by Charles Reed Bishop and William A. Aldrich. Charles Reed Bishop died in 1915, whereas First Hawaiian acquired Pioneer Federal Savings Bank in 1993—about 78 years after his death.
